chapter: Cafe Society and the Zodiac Suite
title: Working with Josh White and Barney Josephson's star-making idea
summary: Josh White was a beautiful person to work with; Josephson booked unknown singers beside stars. She did many benefits at the Cafe.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Josh White was there too, wasn't he?
How did you get along with Josh White?

Oh, Josh White was just beautiful. You know when Barney Josephson booked new singers in his idea was to create a new star within the star that was there. He'd bring a known talent in and show them off. A big star would draw the people in and he'd show somebody unknown off and make a star out of him. Josh White was just terrific to work with, as I said before. We rode uptown together every night; he'd take me home and then he'd go home. He was such a beautiful person to work with. I used to do three or four benefits with him a night.
I did so many benefits at the Cafe that I just don't feel like doing any now.
